user.title: Set up Hearthkeeper
user.description: Choose the Telegram bot Hearthkeeper will listen to. Add allowed chats in the Telegram bot integration first.

error.invalid_telegram_entry: That config entry is not a Telegram bot.

abort.already_configured: This Telegram bot is already used by Hearthkeeper.
abort.no_telegram_bot: No Telegram bot integration found. Set up the Telegram bot integration first.

data_description.pipeline_id: Assist pipeline from Settings > Voice assistants. It already holds the conversation agent, STT, TTS and language. Choose none to echo messages back.
data_description.reply_mode: How to answer agent replies. Commands always answer with text.
data_description.allow_groups: In groups, answer only commands, @mentions and replies to the bot.
data_description.webapp_url: Public HTTPS address Telegram clients use to open the Mini App, for example a tunnel. Leave it empty to use the external or Home Assistant Cloud URL.
data_description.todo_entity: Todo list used by /shop and the shopping section of the briefing. Leave empty to disable both.
data_description.max_voice_seconds: Voice messages longer than this are refused before decoding.
data_description.brief_enabled: Send the briefing every day to every private chat the bot has talked in. /brief works even when this is off.
data_description.brief_time: Local time of the morning briefing.
data_description.brief_calendars: Calendars shown under Today and Tomorrow. Leave empty to skip the section.
data_description.brief_weather: Weather entity shown in the briefing. Leave empty to skip the section.
data_description.brief_mail: IMAP sensors with unread counters. Leave empty to skip the mail section.
data_description.allow_cloud_for_mail: Allow Hearthkeeper to send the senders and subjects of recent messages to your preferred AI Task for a 3–5 line summary. Off by default: mail never leaves the house.
data_description.brief_home: Show lights, open doors and windows, and active climate.
data_description.keep_audio: Keep the original audio sent by the user after processing. Off by default: messages are deleted after transcription.
data_description.quiet_start: Start of quiet hours (e.g. 23:00). During quiet hours the scheduled briefing and reminders are suppressed.
data_description.admins: Telegram user IDs that may change the shared weather, calendars, mailboxes and shopping list from the Mini App. Leave empty to change them here only.
data_description.connection_repositories: GitHub repositories with a connection.json at the root, as owner/repo or owner/repo@branch. Admins can also add them in the Mini App.
data_description.brief_chats: Telegram IDs that get the household morning briefing from these options. It goes only to people who have not set up their own briefings in the Mini App. Leave empty to send it to every private chat. The briefing service without a chat ID also sends here.
data_description.users: Telegram IDs of the people who may use the bot and the Mini App. Leave empty to allow everyone the Telegram integration lets through; a person must be allowed there too.

error.invalid_webapp_url: Use an HTTPS address without a query or fragment.
error.invalid_connection_repo: Use owner/repo or owner/repo@branch for connection plugins.

say.name: Say
say.description: Send a text or voice message to a Telegram chat through Hearthkeeper.

chat_id.name: Chat ID
chat_id.description: Telegram chat ID the bot is allowed to talk to.

text.name: Text
text.description: Message to send. It is spoken when the mode is voice or both.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Text, voice or both. Defaults to the reply mode of the chat.

reset.name: Reset
reset.description: Forget the conversation context of one chat or of every chat.

chat_id.name: Chat ID
chat_id.description: Chat to reset. Omit to reset every chat.

brief.name: Brief
brief.description: Send the daily briefing now, to one chat or to every known private chat.

chat_id.name: Chat ID
chat_id.description: Telegram chat to send the briefing to. Omit to send it to every known private chat.

telegram_entry_missing.message: The Telegram bot config entry no longer exists.

telegram_entry_not_loaded.message: The Telegram bot is not loaded yet. Hearthkeeper will retry.

pipeline_not_ready.message: The Assist pipeline integration is not loaded yet. Hearthkeeper will retry.

pipeline_not_found.message: The Assist pipeline {pipeline_id} no longer exists. Pick another one in the integration options.

unknown_chat.message: Chat {chat_id} does not belong to Hearthkeeper.

not_implemented.message: This action is not implemented yet.
